'''6FT-DP''' was a rust-colored [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was manufactured to serve [[Bioniip Laboratories/Legends|Bioniip Laboratories]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Its model was a 6FT-D2. It served primarily as guard of the Bioniip labs. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, with a flat head and bulky arms to support his powerful, built-in weapons system. The weapons system consisted of a heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] also used a rocket pack. When droid [[X0-X1]] took over Cloud City's computer network, he relinquished 6FT-DP from his primary duty and ordered him to protect the system core. 6FT-DP was enthusiastic about his new position upon discovering that many of the overrides in his programming that had kept him from reaching his full potential had been removed by X0-X1.
